insights.text: 9 filings (2 IPO, 7 PO) would add up to THB 21.52bn of property to Thai REITs, funded by up to THB 12.67bn of new units and THB 10.98bn of new borrowings.
Industrial & Logistics accounts for 63% of deal value across 5 of 9 filings.
Largest deal: PROSPECT at up to THB 5.04bn; smallest: QHHRREIT at up to THB 1.23bn.
Projected distribution yields run from 7.00% (DTPBB2) to 12.88% (MII), each on its own filing's basis price.

7 of 9 deals with appraisal values disclosed are priced at or below the lower independent appraisal; the widest discount is ALLY at -12.9%. Above the lower appraisal: PROSPECT (+5.4%), ALPHART (+0.5%).
Highest post-deal LTV: LHHOTEL at 42.0% against a 60% limit.
14 of 17 new assets are wholly or partly leasehold; 3 are freehold.
Shortest remaining leasehold among new assets: Grand Centre Point Surawong (LHHOTEL), about 27 years to 31 Jul 2053.
Relative to trust size, MII is the biggest step: the acquisition equals 77% of its current total assets.
Maximum PO offer prices versus the last market price quoted in each filing: MII +0.8%, ALLY +4.2%, QHHRREIT +7.2%, WHART +9.9%, PROSPECT +50.0%.
SEC filing stage on 15 Sep 2026: 3 under SEC review, 2 in their offer period, 2 effective, offer not yet open, 1 with the offer closed, 1 under SEC review after amendment.
Least complete extraction: DTPBB2 (67% of applicable fields found in the text filings); gaps are listed per REIT and on the Validation sheet.
17 consistency checks need a look across 8 filings.
